basic_info.description: Light-filled top-floor 1BD/1BA condo in the heart of San Francisco's Theater District. Located at the rear of the building, this unit features 11' ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a private balcony. Bonus work-from-home niche offers added functionality.    Open-concept kitchen with quartz countertops, Italian appliances, gas range, and German-engineered cabinetry. Full-size dishwasher and in-unit washer/dryer included. Wide-plank wood flooring throughout.    The spacious bathroom includes a quartz vanity and contemporary finishes.    Residents enjoy access to a rooftop deck with panoramic city views, lounge seating, fire pits, built-in BBQ, dog run, and WiFi.    The boutique building (built in 2018 from the historic Grauman's Imperial Theater) offers secure package delivery via Luxor Lockers, virtual doorman, weekday lobby attendant, secure mailroom, bike storage, and Mulberry's dry cleaning lockers.    Included: Two deeded storage units + one deeded bike rack.    Close to public transit (1 block to BART and Muni), dining, shopping, and cultural destinations in Union Square, Hayes Valley, and Mission Bay.
